vector<Edge> graph[3005];
vector<int> revIndex[3005];

void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap) {
    graph[u].push_back(Edge(v, cap));
    revIndex[u].push_back(graph[v].size());
    graph[v].push_back(Edge(u, 0));
    revIndex[v].push_back(graph[u].size() - 1);
}

bool bfsLevel(int source, int sink, vector<int>& level) {
    fill(level.begin(), level.end(), -1);
    queue<int> q;
    q.push(source);
    level[source] = 0;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int u = q.front(); q.pop();
        for (int i = 0; i < graph[u].size(); ++i) {
            Edge& e = graph[u][i];
            if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == -1) {
                level[e.to] = level[u] + 1;
                q.push(e.to);
            }
        }
    }
    return level[sink] != -1;
}

int dfs(int u, int sink, int flow, vector<int>& iter, vector<int>& level) {
    if (u == sink) return flow;
    for (int& i = iter[u]; i < graph[u].size(); ++i) {
        Edge& e = graph[u][i];
        if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == level[u] + 1) {
            int pushed = dfs(e.to, sink, min(flow, e.cap), iter, level);
            if (pushed > 0) {
                e.cap -= pushed;
                graph[e.to][revIndex[u][i]].cap += pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int dinic(int source, int sink) {

    vector<int> level(3005);

        int pushed;
        while ((pushed = dfs(source, sink, INF, iter, level)) > 0) {
            flow += pushed;
        }
    }
    return flow;
}
